title: An unaddressed Spanish cipher letter of 8 Jan 1497, in George Lasry's reconstructed alphabet: BnF Espagnol 318 no. 95, f. 122r-v (catalogue item 9)

steps.what: No. 95 key found: Lasry's 2022 alphabet published as an image by Tomokiyo.
No. 95 f. 122r segmented and Ward-clustered, clusters labelled from Lasry's key (64 % clean clusters).
No. 95 hybrid decode checked by eye: franceses, Francia, que puedan, muy grandes cosas; about two thirds of signs; two Lasry signs corrected.
Band-clipped segmentation and DP template tiling for no. 95; no gain beyond the same two thirds.
No. 95 re-examined: cryptiana GL.htm says Lasry solved the letter itself in 2022, not just its alphabet. The page and the ranking (novelty 5 to 3) were corrected.

Split from the former whole-volume target esp318 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): no. 95, the only letter in Lasry's alphabet, is its own entry, with his credit scoped to it. f122r_reading.md moved here; the pipeline stays in targets/esp318/.

outcome.method_basis: Lasry's 2022 alphabet (published as an image on cryptiana) was applied to machine-clustered glyphs of f. 122r and checked by eye on annotated strips; about two thirds of the signs read.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Not measured. f. 122r: about two thirds of its 963 glyphs read (NOTES, three methods agreeing); f. 122v (five lines) not decoded. No figure is given for the whole letter.

gaps.item: f. 122r, about a third of the glyphs
gaps.detail: eye, cluster-hybrid and tiling readings agree on the same two thirds; touching signs at Gallica's 4077-px full resolution; the line-by-line correction walk is still to do
segmented (targets/esp318/f122v_reseg.pkl) but not decoded with the f. 122r templates

outcome.notes: Spanish, about the French and what a Señoría can be made to do; nomenclator groups bac, bon x2, bnh x4, dal, bed? located. Status: in progress (f. 122v not decoded).

credits.note: alphabet of no. 95 reconstructed 2022 (published by Tomokiyo); two signs corrected here

published Lasry's alphabet as an image (cryptiana GL.htm)

prior.where: George Lasry, May 2022: cryptiana GL.htm says the letter 'is solved' and publishes his alphabet as an image; no plaintext published
